sentences.en: MAN: First of all, let me thank you all for coming to this public meeting, to discuss the future of our town.
sentences.zh: MAN: 首先，感谢各位出席本次公众会议，共同探讨我们城镇的未来。

sentences.en: Our first speaker is Shona Ferguson, from Barford town council.
sentences.zh: 我们的第一位发言人是来自巴福德镇议会的肖娜·弗格森。

sentences.en: Shona.
sentences.zh: 肖娜。

sentences.en: SHONA: Thank you.
sentences.zh: SHONA: 谢谢。

sentences.en: First I'll briefly give you some background information, then I'll be asking you for your comments on developments in the town.
sentences.zh: 首先，我将简要向各位介绍一些背景信息，随后会就本镇的发展情况征求各位的意见和建议。

sentences.en: Well, as you don't need me to tell you, Barford has changed a great deal in the last 50 years.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，巴福德镇在过去50年间发生了巨大变化，这一点无需我多言。

sentences.en: These are some of the main changes.
sentences.zh: 以下是其中一些主要变化。

sentences.en: Fifty years ago, buses linked virtually every part of the town and the neighbouring towns and villages.
sentences.zh: 50年前，公交车几乎覆盖了全镇以及周边城镇和村庄的各个角落。

sentences.en: Most people used them frequently, but not now, because the bus companies concentrate on just the routes that attract most passengers.
sentences.zh: 当时大多数人经常乘坐公交车，但如今情况已大不相同，因为公交公司只专注于客流量最大的几条线路。

sentences.en: So parts of the town are no longer served by buses.
sentences.zh: 因此，镇上部分区域已不再有公交车服务。

sentences.en: Even replacing old uncomfortable buses with smart new ones has had little impact on passenger numbers.
sentences.zh: 即便用崭新、舒适的新型公交车取代老旧车辆，对乘客数量的提升也收效甚微。

sentences.en: It's sometimes said that bus fares are too high, but in relation to average incomes, fares are not much higher than they were 50 years ago.
sentences.zh: 人们有时抱怨公交票价过高，但若以平均收入为参照，当前票价与50年前相比并未显著上涨。

sentences.en: Changes in the road network are affecting the town.
sentences.zh: 道路网络的变化正影响着本镇。

sentences.en: The centre was recently closed to traffic on a trial basis, making it much safer for pedestrians.
sentences.zh: 市中心最近试行了交通管制措施，禁止车辆通行，从而大幅提升了行人的安全性。

sentences.en: The impact of this is being measured.
sentences.zh: 这一措施的影响正在被评估中。

sentences.en: The new cycle paths, separating bikes from cars in most main roads, are being used far more than was expected, reducing traffic and improving air quality.
sentences.zh: 新建的自行车道将自行车与机动车在大多数主干道上分隔开来，其使用频率远超预期，有效减少了交通拥堵并改善了空气质量。

sentences.en: And although the council's attempts to have a bypass constructed have failed, we haven't given up hope of persuading the government to change its mind.
sentences.zh: 尽管议会多次尝试推动建设绕城公路却屡遭失败，但我们仍未放弃说服政府改变立场的希望。

sentences.en: Shopping in the town centre has changed over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，镇中心的购物状况也发生了变化。

sentences.en: Many of us can remember when the town was crowded with people going shopping.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人仍记得当年镇上人潮涌动、熙熙攘攘的购物景象。

sentences.en: Numbers have been falling for several years, despite efforts to attract shoppers, for instance by opening new car parks.
sentences.zh: 尽管采取了多种措施（例如新建停车场）以吸引顾客，但近年来镇中心购物人数持续下降。

sentences.en: Some people combine shopping with visits to the town's restaurants and cafés.
sentences.zh: 有些人将购物与参观镇上的餐厅和咖啡馆结合起来。

sentences.en: Most shops are small independent stores, which is good, but many people prefer to use supermarkets.
sentences.zh: 大多数商店都是小型的独立店铺，这很好，但许多人更喜欢去超市购物。

sentences.en: and department stores in nearby large towns, as there are so few well-known chain.
sentences.zh: 以及附近大城镇的百货公司，因为这里知名连锁店实在太少了。

sentences.en: stores here.
sentences.zh: 这里的连锁店。

sentences.en: Turning now to medical facilities, the town is served by family doctors in several medical practices - fewer than 50 years ago, but each catering for far more patients.
sentences.zh: 现在转向医疗设施：该镇由几家诊所的家庭医生提供服务——相比50年前数量减少了，但每家诊所服务的患者人数却大幅增加。

sentences.en: Our hospital closed 15 years ago, which means journeys to other towns are unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 我们的医院15年前关闭了，这意味着人们不得不前往其他城镇就医。

sentences.en: On the other hand, there are more dentists than there used to be.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，牙医的数量比过去增加了。

sentences.en: Employment patterns have changed, along with almost everything else.
sentences.zh: 就业模式发生了变化，几乎其他所有方面也都发生了变化。

sentences.en: The number of schools and colleges has increased, making that the main employment sector.
sentences.zh: 学校和学院的数量有所增加，使其成为主要的就业领域。

sentences.en: Services, such as website design and accountancy, have grown in importance, and surprisingly, perhaps, manufacturing hasn't seen the decline that has affected it in other parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 诸如网站设计和会计等服务行业的重要性日益提升；令人惊讶的是，制造业并未像国内其他地区那样出现衰退。

sentences.en: Now I'll very quickly outline current plans for some of the town's facilities, before asking for your comments.
sentences.zh: 接下来我将简要概述镇上部分设施的当前规划，然后征求各位的意见。

sentences.en: As you'll know if you regularly use the car park at the railway station, it's usually full.
sentences.zh: 如果您经常使用火车站停车场，就会知道它通常总是停满车辆。

sentences.en: The railway company applied for permission to replace it with a multi-storey car park, but that was refused.
sentences.zh: 铁路公司曾申请许可，将该停车场改建为多层停车场，但申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Instead, the company has bought some adjoining land, and this.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，该公司购买了一些相邻的土地，而这部分土地

sentences.en: will be used to increase the number of parking spaces.
sentences.zh: 将被用来增加停车位数量。

sentences.en: The Grand, the old cinema in the high street, will close at the end of the year, and reopen on a different site.
sentences.zh: 位于主街的老电影院‘大剧院’将于今年年底关闭，并在另一处地点重新开业。

sentences.en: You've probably seen the building under construction.
sentences.zh: 您可能已经看到了正在建设中的那栋建筑。

sentences.en: The plan is to have three screens with fewer seats, rather than just the one large auditorium in the old cinema.
sentences.zh: 计划是设置三个影厅，每个影厅座位数减少，而不是像老电影院那样仅设一个大型放映厅。

sentences.en: I expect many of you shop in the indoor market.
sentences.zh: 我想在座的许多人都会在室内市场购物。

sentences.en: It's become more and more shabby- looking, and because of fears about safety, it was threatened with demolition.
sentences.zh: 室内市场外观变得越来越破旧，而且由于安全方面的担忧，它一度面临被拆除的威胁。

sentences.en: The good news is that it will close for six weeks to be made safe and redecorated, and the improved building will open in July.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，图书馆将关闭六周以进行安全加固和重新装修，改造后的建筑将于七月重新开放。

sentences.en: Lots of people use the library, including school and college students who go there to study.
sentences.zh: 许多人使用这座图书馆，其中包括前往那里学习的中小学生和大学生。

sentences.en: The council has managed to secure funding to keep the library open later into the evening, twice a week.
sentences.zh: 市议会已成功争取到资金，使图书馆每周有两个晚上延长开放时间。

sentences.en: We would like to enlarge the building in the not-too-distant future, but this is by no means definite.
sentences.zh: 我们希望在不久的将来扩建这座建筑，但此事目前远未确定。

sentences.en: There's no limit on access to the nature reserve on the edge of town, and this will continue to be the case.
sentences.zh: 镇郊的自然保护区对公众开放不受限制，这种情况将继续保持下去。

sentences.en: What will change, though, is that the council will no longer be in charge of the area.
sentences.zh: 不过，将发生变化的是，该区域将不再由市议会负责管理。

sentences.en: Instead it will become the responsibility of a national body that administers most nature reserves in the country.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，它将由一个负责管理全国大多数自然保护区的国家级机构接管。

sentences.en: OK, now let me ask you ...
sentences.zh: 好的，现在让我来问你们……
